origin.description: Nested adaptive quadrature over a rectangle. dim chooses which variable is inner.
origin.usage: dblquad(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, dim = 2, ..., subdivs = 300, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Vectorized function of x and y.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: 2 integrates y first, 1 integrates x first.

arguments.name: subdivs
arguments.text: Subdivision limit passed to the inner integrator.

origin.value: Nested adaptive quadrature over a rectangle. dim chooses which variable is inner.
